subject: Future Tech
title: The Artemis Program
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Artemis Program.

hook.text: Artemis is NASA's program to return humans to the Moon for the first time since Apollo 17 left in December 1972.

buildup.text: Artemis I circled the Moon uncrewed in 2022. Artemis II will carry astronauts around it. Artemis III will land on it.

discovery.text: The program includes the Gateway station in lunar orbit and SpaceX's Starship as the lunar lander vehicle.

twist.text: Delays and budget overruns pushed the first landing from 2025 to at least 2027. Politics and funding remain fragile.

climax.text: Artemis aims to land the first woman and first person of color on the Moon, marking a new era of inclusion in space.

punchline.text: Artemis picks up where Apollo left off, fifty years later.

quiz.question: What role does SpaceX's Starship play in the Artemis program?
